scope: Node VM source logic, markup strings, static assets and PostCSS syntax only

checks.name: eight cases and unique IDs
case contract includes user, trigger, authority and acceptance
cases have both independent evidence and permission facts
all choice cases have at least two candidates
initial candidate is not preselected
initial confirm is disabled in generated markup
unselected confirmation writes no local record
selection records local intent, never a Runtime receipt
duplicate confirmation is ignored
conflict does not mark success
conflict cannot prevent review exit
offline does not mark success
offline cannot prevent review exit
stale does not mark success
stale cannot prevent review exit
stale source clears old candidate and blocks new acceptance
refresh clears candidate and records no Runtime activity
reset preserves old local records
business recommendation is disabled before an initial choice
business recommendation enabled after initial choice
B03 records handoff only, not execution
B04 records handoff only, not execution
budget continuation does not claim to create a Run
Agent-owned retry does not require input
partial Worker case requires explicit choice
file acknowledgment does not approve business Gate
library risk filter selects R3 alone
library supports explicit empty state
HTML escaping prevents source text injecting markup
no application network or provider calls
CSP blocks network connections on both pages
no external scripts, styles or media dependencies
local HTML references resolve
Markdown local links resolve
Tabler icon assets have all requested symbols
design source image exists with expected original size
new text artifacts contain no trailing whitespace or conflict markers
responsive CSS parses with repository PostCSS
